newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Electron shares rise to high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Electron shares rise to high for 1997.

text.p: Shares of Tokyo Electron Ltd remained on a rising trend on Thursday, hitting a high for this calendar year.
Brokers attributed the bullishness to the company's expected strong earnings results. They added that semiconductor-related firms are also attracting investors.
The share price briefly climbed to 4,880, the highest price so far in 1997. At 0145 GMT, it stood 40 yen higher at 4,830.
"As the earnings season nears, issues with strong earnings prospects, such as semiconductor-related shares, are attracting investors," said a broker at a "Big Four" securities house.
